# HLS player

`hls.min.js` is the unmodified hls.js **1.6.13** distribution, stored locally so playback does not depend on a CDN at runtime.

- Release: https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js/releases/tag/v1.6.13
- Download: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/hls.js@1.6.13/dist/hls.min.js
- SHA-256: `7c47cd97d7a6e7b98d9623dd8ed9a6d45af4be4085e0c2001cd7175c2b4cfb07`
- License: [Apache 2.0](hls.LICENSE.txt)

Update this file, the bundle, its license, and the checksum together when changing versions. Source maps are not required for playback and are not bundled.
